pr.title: Migrate container runtime from Docker to Kubernetes (k3s)
pr.description:
Replace Docker-based container management with Kubernetes using k3s for
local development. Introduces ContainerBackend protocol, KubernetesClient,
KubernetesSpawner, Kustomize manifests with Calico NetworkPolicies for
agent isolation, and migrates CI/CD to k3s. Removes all Docker Compose
files and Docker SDK dependencies.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: Unit tests for KubernetesClient, KubernetesSpawner, ContainerBackend protocol conformance, and gateway token auth.
- Manual: Run make k3s-setup && make deploy, verify pods healthy, verify agent isolation.
pr.manual_steps:
Pre-merge: Install k3s with Calico CNI via make k3s-setup.
Post-merge: Update developer documentation to reflect k3s prerequisite.
